chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam and Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan al-Jammal, who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him): 'Some people say: Perform the Hajj exclusively (Qiran), and some people say: Pair it and bring the sacrificial animal, and some people say: Perform Tamattu' with the Umra until the Hajj.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'If I were to perform Hajj for a thousand years, I would not pair it except as a Mutamatti'.'

key_terms.اقْرُنْ: Pair (referring to Qiran, combining Umra and Hajj)
key_terms.تَمَتَّعْ: Perform Tamattu' (a type of Hajj where Umra is performed first, then Hajj separately)
key_terms.جَرِّدِ الْحَجَّ: Perform Hajj exclusively (often referring to Qiran or Hajj al-Qiran)
key_terms.مُتَمَتِّعاً: As a Mutamatti' (one who performs Tamattu')

ai.seo_question: What is the difference between Qiran and Tamattu' in Hajj according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) resolves the juristic debate between Qiran (combining Umra and Hajj) and Tamattu' (separating them) by declaring his personal preference for Tamattu', even if he were to perform a thousand Hajjs. This narration is pivotal in Shia fiqh as it establishes the superiority of Tamattu' as the recommended method, reflecting the Prophet's practice and offering a model of spiritual renewal through distinct rituals. The Imam’s emphatic statement underscores the flexibility within Hajj types while highlighting the spiritual benefits of separating the minor pilgrimage from the major one.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, and Ibn Abu Najran, from Safwan Al Jammal who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Some of the people are saying, ‘The Hajj is performed exclusively’, and some of the people are saying, ‘Pair it (with Umra) and usher (the sacrificial animal)’, and some of the people are saying, ‘Perform Tamatto with the Umra to the Hajj’. So heasws said: ‘If Iasws were to perform Hajj for a thousand years, Iasws would not be pairing it except with the Tamatto ’.
en.sarwar: 6. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from Mu‘awiyah who has said the following: “Abu `Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘One who performs al-Hajj should take advantage (al- Mut‘ah); we do not compromise with the book of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, and the Sunnah of His Holy prophet, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause.”’
